nodes.name: Read Policies
nodes.notes: Reads the whole tab with NO filter on purpose. The Sheets node's 'Column to match on' is a dropdown populated from the sheet at edit time and can import empty, which fails at runtime as 'The column "" could not be found'. The next Code node does the matching instead. Always Output Data is ON so an empty tab still reaches the Respond node.

nodes.name: Append Claim Row
nodes.notes: Auto-Map Input Data: the previous Code node emits exactly the ten Claims columns, matched to headers at run time. No per-column mapping to configure, and nothing for an import to drop.
